coverage.description: Graph-based plugin ordering and metadata analysis. Current CLI supports --auto-sort when --game is supplied.
known_gaps: successful sort cannot merge semantic record conflicts
masterlist/user metadata may be incomplete or wrong for unpublished/private mods
coverage.denominator_probe: plugins discovered vs plugins sorted/metadata-evaluated; cycle/error count.

requires_confirmation_for: applying sorted order to a non-test profile
safety.sandbox_or_scope: Prefer cloned/dedicated MO2 test profile and retain LOOT load-order backup.

verification.output_readback: Compare before/after load order and parse errors/messages.

ai.context_cost_notes: Ordering oracle, not semantic compatibility oracle.

evidence.notes: Latest GitHub release observed is 0.29.2; docs expose --auto-sort, --game-path and --loot-data-path.
